summary: Comprehensive testing of P0 fixes for GHG Platform. All backend tests (12/12) passed. Frontend UI tests verified: Super Admin redirect to /super-admin, Admin redirect to /dashboard, dashboard loading, emission factors dropdown, and file upload/download functionality.

minor.issue: Some old evidence files return 404 (files deleted from previous tests) - not a code issue, data cleanup needed

critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings in React about '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - minor hydration issue from development tooling, does not affect functionality
Consider cleaning up orphaned file references in emissions that point to deleted files
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 fixes tested successfully: 1) Super Admin login redirects to /super-admin, 2) Admin login redirects to /dashboard, 3) Super Admin dashboard shows organizations chart with 4 orgs and 9 facilities, 4) Admin without org_id returns empty data gracefully (no 500 errors), 5) Evidence file download works when file exists, 6) Standard emission factors visible in dropdown (Stationary Combustion, Mobile Combustion, etc.), 7) Custom emission factors appear alongside standard factors. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_p0_fixes.py covers all P0 fixes.
